name: Lemon herb chicken with roasted vegetables
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Line a rimmed sheet pan with parchment.
Cut vegetables into bite-size pieces; toss with half the oil and a pinch of salt and pepper. Spread in a single layer.
Pat chicken dry; coat with remaining oil, lemon juice, minced garlic and Italian seasoning. Place beside vegetables.
Roast 20–30 minutes, turning vegetables halfway. Check thickest chicken piece for 165°F; remove smaller pieces sooner.
Rest chicken 5 minutes. Serve with vegetables and remaining lemon wedges.

name: Grilled pineapple chicken with coconut rice
steps: Whisk oil, lime juice and minced garlic in a bowl. Coat chicken and refrigerate 15 minutes.
Rinse rice; combine with coconut milk, water and salt in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low 15–20 minutes or until tender; rest 5 minutes.
Preheat grill to medium-high and oil grates. Grill chicken 5–8 minutes per side, depending on thickness, to 165°F.
Grill pineapple on a grill basket or skewers 2–3 minutes per side. Slice rested chicken and serve over fluffed rice.

name: Lemon garlic chicken and pearl couscous
steps: Pat chicken dry and season with salt and pepper. Heat half the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear chicken 5–8 minutes per side until 165°F; transfer to a plate and rest.
Reduce heat to medium. Add remaining oil, minced garlic and couscous; stir 1–2 minutes.
Add broth, bring to a simmer and cover 10–12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender. Add a splash of water if dry.
Stir in lemon juice and chopped parsley. Slice chicken and serve over couscous. For GF use rice and follow its package directions.

name: Sheet pan turkey meatballs and vegetables
ing: 4 cups broccoli, carrots, zucchini and onion
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F; line a rimmed sheet pan.
Mix turkey, egg, crumbs and a pinch of salt and pepper gently. Shape into 16 equal balls.
Cut vegetables into bite-size pieces and toss with oil. Arrange with meatballs in a single layer.
Roast 18–22 minutes, turning vegetables halfway, until meatballs reach 165°F.
Mix coconut aminos with minced garlic and toss with hot meatballs and vegetables. Serve immediately.

name: Crispy ground turkey smash tacos
ing: ½ tsp each garlic powder, smoked paprika and onion powder
1 tbsp neutral oil, or as needed for cooking
steps: Mix turkey with garlic powder, paprika, onion powder, salt and pepper. Divide into eight portions.
Press each portion into a thin, even layer on one side of a corn tortilla.
Heat a lightly oiled skillet over medium-high heat. Cook two tacos at a time, meat-side down, 3–4 minutes.
Flip and cook 2–3 minutes more until turkey reaches 165°F. Repeat with remaining tacos.
Top with shredded lettuce, pickled onions, sliced avocado and burger sauce. Serve immediately while crisp.

name: Chicken and crispy potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Halve potatoes and pat dry.
Toss potatoes with 2 tbsp oil and half the seasonings. Spread cut-side down on a sheet pan; roast 15 minutes.
Coat chicken with remaining oil and seasonings. Add to pan, leaving space between pieces.
Roast another 18–25 minutes, until chicken reaches 165°F and potatoes are fork-tender. Rest chicken 5 minutes.
Serve without sauce; add salt and pepper to taste.

name: Chipotle-style chicken bowls
steps: Cook rice according to package directions. Fluff with lime juice and optional cilantro.
Mix oil, cumin, paprika, minced garlic and juice of one lime. Coat chicken.
Heat a grill or skillet over medium-high heat; cook chicken 5–8 minutes per side to 165°F. Rest 5 minutes and chop.
Drain and rinse beans; warm with corn in a saucepan over medium heat 3–5 minutes.
Divide rice, chicken, beans, corn, lettuce and avocado among bowls. Finish with remaining lime.

name: Cajun turkey sausage pasta
ing: 1 tbsp neutral oil, or as needed for cooking
steps: Bring salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package; drain.
Slice sausage, pepper and onion. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat with a little oil.
Brown sausage 3–5 minutes; add vegetables and sauté 5–7 minutes until tender. If sausage is raw, cook to 165°F.
Add broth, cream and mild Cajun seasoning; simmer 5 minutes over medium-low heat.
Toss with pasta; add a splash of pasta water if sauce is too thick. Taste before adding salt.

name: Smoked turkey sausage rice bowls
steps: Slice sausage into rounds and peppers and onion into strips. Warm cooked rice separately.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown sausage 3–5 minutes.
Add peppers, onion and paprika; cook 5–7 minutes, stirring, until crisp-tender. Raw turkey sausage must reach 165°F.
Divide hot rice among bowls and top with sausage and vegetables. Season to taste.

name: Easy ground turkey meatballs
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet.
Mince garlic. Gently mix ground turkey, egg, crumbs, garlic and Italian seasoning; add salt and pepper to taste.
Shape into 16 equal meatballs and arrange with space between them.
Bake 18–22 minutes until centers reach 165°F. Rest 3 minutes before serving.

name: Ground turkey stuffed peppers
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Halve peppers lengthwise and remove seeds.
Brown turkey in a skillet over medium-high heat 6–8 minutes, breaking it up, to 165°F.
Stir in cooked rice, tomato sauce and Italian seasoning; simmer 2–3 minutes.
Arrange peppers in a baking dish, fill evenly and cover with foil. Bake 30 minutes or until peppers are tender and filling is 165°F.
Uncover for the final 5 minutes if desired; rest briefly before serving.

name: Ground turkey vegetable stir-fry
steps: Mince garlic and ginger; cut vegetables into even pieces.
Heat half the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown turkey 6–8 minutes to 165°F; transfer to a plate.
Add remaining oil and vegetables; stir-fry 4–6 minutes until crisp-tender. Add garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return turkey, add soy sauce and toss 1–2 minutes. Serve hot; use coconut aminos for soy-free.

name: Whole roasted chicken
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Remove giblets and pat chicken dry; do not rinse.
Rub skin with oil, thyme, salt and pepper. Place halved lemon and garlic loosely inside cavity.
Set breast-side up on a rack in a roasting pan. Roast 60–85 minutes, checking early.
Check breast and innermost thigh for 165°F without touching bone. Tent loosely with foil if browning too quickly.
Rest 15 minutes before carving. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

name: Mediterranean turkey and rice skillet
steps: Dice onion and zucchini; mince garlic. Heat a large skillet with a little oil over medium-high heat.
Brown turkey and onion 6–8 minutes, breaking up meat. Add zucchini and cook 4–5 minutes.
Stir in garlic and oregano for 30 seconds; check turkey reaches 165°F.
Add cooked rice and lemon juice; stir until steaming hot. Season to taste and serve.

name: Mediterranean chicken broccoli and feta skillet
steps: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces and broccoli into florets. Mince garlic.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chicken 6–8 minutes, stirring, to 165°F.
Add broccoli, garlic and 2 tbsp water. Cover and steam 4–5 minutes until broccoli is bright and tender.
Uncover, stir in lemon juice and crumble dairy-free feta over top. Taste and serve.

name: Chicken and bacon creamy skillet
steps: Chop bacon and cook in a large skillet over medium heat until crisp; transfer to paper towels.
Pat chicken dry and season. Sear in a little bacon fat 5–8 minutes per side to 165°F; remove.
Add minced garlic to skillet for 30 seconds. Pour in broth and scrape browned bits; simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in cream and simmer gently 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. Return chicken and spoon sauce over it.
Top with crumbled bacon and serve hot.

name: Ninja Speedi chicken broccoli and brown rice
steps: Use instant brown rice, not regular brown rice. Add rice and package-specified water to Speedi pot.
Place crisper tray in upper position; coat chicken with oil and garlic powder and arrange on tray.
Select Speedi Meals at 390°F for 15–20 minutes. Check rice tenderness and chicken temperature (165°F); extend if needed.
Steam broccoli separately 4–5 minutes until crisp-tender. Fluff rice and serve with chicken and broccoli. Follow model-specific liquid minimums.

name: Mexican chicken and russet potato skillet
steps: Dice potatoes into ½-inch cubes, chicken into bite-size pieces and onion finely.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add potatoes and a splash of water; cover 8–10 minutes until nearly tender.
Uncover and cook 4–6 minutes until crisp. Transfer potatoes to a plate.
Add chicken, onion, cumin and paprika; cook 7–10 minutes, stirring, until chicken reaches 165°F.
Return potatoes and toss until hot. Season to taste.

name: Gluten-free chicken pizza pockets
steps: Heat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet. Divide dough into four equal pieces.
Roll each piece between parchment sheets according to dough package instructions.
Mix cooked chicken with marinara. Place filling and cheese on one half of each dough piece, leaving a border.
Fold over and pinch edges closed. Cut a small steam vent in each pocket.
Bake 15–20 minutes until golden and filling reaches 165°F. Cool 5 minutes before eating.

name: One-skillet garlic chicken fried rice
ing: 1 tbsp neutral oil, or as needed for cooking
steps: Chop chicken and mince garlic. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat with a little neutral oil.
Cook vegetables 3–4 minutes. Push aside, add beaten eggs and scramble until set.
Add rice and stir-fry 3–5 minutes, breaking up clumps.
Add chicken, garlic, soy sauce and sesame oil. Toss 2–4 minutes until chicken and rice reach 165°F.
Serve immediately; use coconut aminos if avoiding soy.

name: One-pan chicken sweet potatoes and spinach
steps: Peel and dice sweet potatoes into ½-inch cubes. Dice chicken and mince garlic.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add potatoes and a splash of water; cover 8–10 minutes.
Uncover and cook until potatoes are nearly tender. Add chicken and cook 7–10 minutes to 165°F.
Add garlic for 30 seconds, then spinach in batches until wilted. Season and serve.

name: Sweet potato chicken curry
steps: Dice chicken, onion and peeled sweet potatoes. Heat a little oil in a deep skillet over medium heat.
Sauté onion 4 minutes, add chicken and curry powder and stir 3–4 minutes.
Add sweet potatoes and coconut milk; bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and cook about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender and chicken reaches 165°F.
Taste and season; thin with water if needed. Serve over rice if desired.

name: Creamy garlic chicken thigh pasta
steps: Cook pasta in salted water according to package; reserve ½ cup cooking water and drain.
Cut thighs into bite-size pieces. Heat a little oil in a skillet or Speedi on Sear/Sauté; brown chicken 7–10 minutes to 165°F.
Add minced garlic for 30 seconds. Pour in broth and scrape browned bits.
Stir in cream and simmer gently 4–5 minutes. Toss with pasta; loosen with reserved water as needed.
Season to taste and serve hot.

name: Creamy rotisserie chicken spinach pasta
steps: Cook pasta according to package; reserve a little cooking water and drain.
Mince garlic and shred chicken. Heat a little oil in a large skillet over medium heat; sauté garlic 30 seconds.
Add cream and chicken; simmer gently until chicken reaches 165°F.
Add spinach and stir until wilted, 1–2 minutes. Toss with pasta and loosen with cooking water if needed.
Taste and serve immediately.

name: Chicken pesto pasta
steps: Bring salted water to a boil and cook pasta; add peas for the final 2–3 minutes.
Reserve ½ cup pasta water, then drain. Warm cooked chicken in a skillet with a splash of water to 165°F.
Add pasta, peas and pesto; toss over low heat, adding pasta water a tablespoon at a time.
Serve warm; avoid boiling pesto to preserve its flavor.

name: Greek chicken bowls
steps: Mix lemon juice, oil and oregano; coat chicken. Dice cucumber and warm rice.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 5–8 minutes per side to 165°F.
Rest chicken 5 minutes, then slice. Divide rice among four bowls.
Add chicken and cucumber; spoon tzatziki over each bowl. Serve with extra lemon if desired.

name: BBQ chicken flatbreads
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Place flatbreads on a baking sheet.
Slice onion thinly. Toss chicken with half the BBQ sauce.
Spread remaining sauce over flatbreads; top with chicken, onion and cheese.
Bake 10–12 minutes until edges are crisp and chicken reaches 165°F. Slice and serve.

name: Chicken-stuffed sweet potatoes
steps: Scrub potatoes and pierce each several times. Microwave individually 5–8 minutes, turning halfway, until soft.
Warm chicken and BBQ sauce in a skillet over medium heat with a splash of water to 165°F.
Split potatoes lengthwise and fluff the insides with a fork.
Divide chicken among potatoes and top with sliced green onions. Serve hot.

name: Creamy chicken mushroom pasta
steps: Cook pasta according to package; reserve a little water and drain.
Slice mushrooms and dice chicken. Heat a little oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Brown chicken 5–7 minutes, add mushrooms and cook 4–5 minutes until browned.
Add broth and cream; simmer gently until chicken reaches 165°F and sauce thickens slightly.
Toss with pasta, loosen with reserved water if needed and season to taste.

name: Buffalo chicken stuffed peppers
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Halve peppers and remove seeds.
Mix cooked chicken, mild buffalo sauce and softened dairy-free cream cheese.
Arrange peppers in a baking dish and fill evenly. Add a splash of water to bottom of dish.
Bake 25 minutes until peppers are tender and filling reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

name: Balsamic glazed chicken thighs
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Pat thighs dry and place in a baking dish.
Whisk vinegar, oil, minced garlic and thyme. Coat thighs evenly.
Roast 25–30 minutes, checking earlier for boneless pieces, until thickest part reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes and spoon pan juices over chicken. Serve with vegetables or rice.

name: Coconut chicken lentil curry
steps: Rinse lentils; dice onion and chicken. Heat a little oil in a deep skillet over medium heat.
Sauté onion 4 minutes, add chicken and curry powder and stir 3 minutes.
Add lentils, coconut milk and broth; bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lentils are soft and chicken reaches 165°F. Add water if too thick.
Taste and season; serve warm.

name: Turkey sweet potato skillet
steps: Peel and dice sweet potatoes; chop onion. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add potatoes and a splash of water; cover 8–10 minutes until nearly tender.
Add turkey, onion and paprika. Break up meat and cook 7–10 minutes to 165°F.
Uncover and cook until excess moisture evaporates. Season to taste and serve.

name: Ground turkey taco bowls
steps: Warm cooked rice and drained beans separately. Slice avocado.
Brown turkey in a skillet over medium-high heat 6–8 minutes, breaking it up.
Add taco seasoning and 2 tbsp water; simmer 2–3 minutes until turkey reaches 165°F.
Divide rice, beans, turkey and avocado among bowls. Serve hot.

name: Cauliflower crust pizza
steps: Preheat oven according to crust package. If required, prebake crust on a baking sheet.
Spread marinara thinly over crust. Scatter cooked chicken and dairy-free cheese evenly.
Bake according to package until crust is crisp and chicken reaches 165°F.
Rest 2 minutes, slice and serve. Avoid overloading crust with toppings.

name: Italian turkey sausage peppers onions and crispy potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Dice potatoes and toss with half the oil and seasoning.
Roast potatoes on a sheet pan 30–35 minutes, turning halfway.
Slice sausage, peppers and onion. Heat remaining oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Brown sausage 3–5 minutes; add vegetables and cook 5–7 minutes. Raw turkey sausage must reach 165°F.
Toss with crisp potatoes and serve.

name: Onion gravy chicken with mashed potatoes and green beans
steps: Slice onions and trim green beans. Warm prepared mashed potatoes.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Season chicken and sear 5–8 minutes per side to 165°F; remove.
Reduce heat to medium; cook onions 10–15 minutes until golden. Stir in flour for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in broth and simmer 4–6 minutes until thick. Return chicken and coat with gravy.
Steam green beans 4–6 minutes until tender. Serve chicken and gravy over potatoes with beans.

name: One-pan cheesy chicken and rice
steps: Dice chicken and onion. Heat a little oil in a deep skillet over medium-high heat.
Brown chicken and onion 5–6 minutes. Stir in dry rice and broth; bring to a simmer.
Cover, reduce heat to low and cook 18–22 minutes until rice is tender and chicken reaches 165°F.
Remove from heat, stir in cheese and cover 2 minutes. Add a splash of broth if dry; serve.

name: Southwest chicken sweet potato skillet
steps: Dice sweet potatoes and chicken; drain and rinse beans.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add potatoes and a splash of water; cover 8–10 minutes.
Add chicken, cumin and paprika; cook 7–10 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F and potatoes are tender.
Stir in beans and heat 2–3 minutes. Season and serve.

name: Chicken meatballs
steps: Heat oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan. Mince garlic.
Gently mix ground chicken, egg, crumbs, garlic and oregano; season to taste.
Shape into 16 equal meatballs and space on pan.
Bake about 20 minutes until centers reach 165°F. Rest 3 minutes and serve.

name: Honey mustard chicken
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Pat chicken dry and place in a lightly greased baking dish.
Whisk Dijon, honey (or maple syrup) and oil; brush over chicken.
Bake 20–25 minutes, depending on thickness, until chicken reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing; spoon cooked glaze over chicken.

name: Classic pot roast
steps: Pat roast dry; season with salt and pepper. Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear roast 3–4 minutes per side; remove. Sauté chopped onion 4 minutes and garlic 30 seconds.
Add broth, scrape browned bits, return roast and add herbs. Cover and bake at 300°F for 3–4 hours.
Add peeled carrots and potatoes for final 90 minutes. Cook until meat pulls apart easily with a fork.
Rest roast 10 minutes. Skim fat from juices; thicken with a cornstarch slurry if desired.

name: Country-style BBQ pork ribs
ing: 1 tsp each smoked paprika, garlic powder and onion powder
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Pat ribs dry and rub with spices, sugar, salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat; sear ribs 2–3 minutes per side. Remove.
Sauté sliced onion 4 minutes and garlic 30 seconds. Add broth and BBQ sauce; return ribs.
Cover and bake 1½–2 hours until fork-tender. Uncover, brush with sauce and increase oven to 425°F.
Bake 10–15 minutes until glaze is sticky. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

name: Garlic herb beef shoulder steak
steps: Mix oil, minced garlic, rosemary, thyme, paprika, salt and pepper. Coat steak and refrigerate 20 minutes.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Remove excess marinade from steak.
Sear 4–5 minutes per side, adjusting for thickness, until center reaches 145°F.
Rest at least 3 minutes; slice thinly across grain. Serve with mashed potatoes and green beans.

name: Mustard glazed pork chops
ing: ½ tsp each smoked paprika and garlic powder
steps: Pat chops dry and season with paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Whisk Dijon, maple syrup and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat; sear chops 3–4 minutes per side, adjusting for thickness.
Brush glaze on during final minute; cook to 145°F. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

name: Moroccan meatballs with chickpeas
steps: Mix beef, egg, crumbs, cumin, cinnamon and paprika; shape into 16 meatballs.
Slice onion and peppers; drain chickpeas. Heat oil in deep skillet over medium-high heat.
Brown meatballs 2–3 minutes per side; add onion and peppers and cook 4 minutes.
Add chickpeas and broth, cover and simmer 15–20 minutes until meatballs reach 160°F.
Taste sauce and season; serve warm.

name: Easy weeknight enchiladas
ing: 1 lb ground beef or cooked shredded chicken
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Spread a thin layer of enchilada sauce in a 9×13-inch dish.
Brown beef to 160°F or use cooked chicken. Add seasoning and water; simmer 5 minutes.
Warm tortillas briefly to make pliable. Divide meat and half the cheese among tortillas and roll.
Arrange seam-side down; pour remaining sauce over and sprinkle remaining cheese.
Bake 15–20 minutes until bubbling and filling reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes.

name: Healthy ground beef casserole
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Dice onion and mince garlic.
Brown beef and onion in skillet over medium-high heat 6–8 minutes to 160°F; drain excess fat. Add garlic 30 seconds.
Mix with cooked rice, vegetables, broth and Italian seasoning.
Transfer to greased 9×13-inch dish; sprinkle cheese on top. Bake 20–25 minutes until center reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

name: Lebanese beef kafta bowls
ing: 1 tbsp neutral oil, or as needed for cooking
steps: Finely mince onion, parsley and garlic; reserve one garlic clove for sauce. Mix beef with onion, parsley, remaining garlic, cumin, coriander, allspice, paprika, cinnamon and salt.
Shape into 12 oblong patties. Heat lightly oiled skillet over medium-high heat; sear 3–4 minutes per side to 160°F.
Warm rice in separate skillet with turmeric and 3 tbsp water; stir until steaming. Add lemon juice to taste if desired.
Whisk mayo, lemon juice and reserved garlic; thin with 1–2 tbsp water. Slice cucumber and drain pickled onions.
Divide rice among bowls; add kafta, cucumber, onions and sauce. Serve immediately.

name: Sticky Korean beef and crispy potato bowls
ing: 1 tbsp each ketchup, sesame oil and vinegar
1 tbsp neutral oil, or as needed for cooking
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cube potatoes and cut carrots into sticks. Toss separately with a little oil and salt.
Roast potatoes 35–40 minutes, turning halfway; add carrots on separate pan for final 20–25 minutes.
Dice onion and mince garlic. Brown beef and onion in skillet 6–8 minutes to 160°F; drain excess fat.
Add garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sugar, ketchup, sesame oil and vinegar; simmer 3–5 minutes until sticky.
Serve beef over crispy potatoes with carrots and lettuce. Use coconut aminos if avoiding soy.

name: Korean beef rice bowls
steps: Warm cooked rice and slice green onions. Mince garlic and ginger.
Brown ground beef in skillet over medium-high heat 6–8 minutes to 160°F; drain excess fat.
Add garlic and ginger for 30 seconds. Stir in soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil; simmer 3 minutes.
Divide rice among bowls and top with beef and green onions. Taste before adding salt.

name: Mediterranean kofta with lemon potatoes and asparagus
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cube potatoes; toss with 2 tbsp oil and lemon juice. Roast 35 minutes, turning halfway.
Trim asparagus, toss with remaining oil and add to pan for final 12 minutes.
Mix ground beef, minced onion, parsley, cumin, coriander and allspice. Shape into 12 patties.
Sear in hot skillet 3–4 minutes per side to 160°F.
Serve kofta with potatoes and asparagus; season to taste.

name: French onion beef penne
steps: Slice onions thinly. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat; cook onions 20–30 minutes, stirring until golden.
Cook penne according to package; reserve ½ cup water and drain.
Add ground beef to onions; cook 6–8 minutes to 160°F, breaking up meat. Drain excess fat.
Add broth, Worcestershire, Dijon and thyme; simmer 10 minutes until reduced.
Toss with penne; loosen with reserved water if needed. Taste and serve.
tips: Timing note: allow 40–50 minutes for properly browned onions and the finished sauce.

name: Classic homemade meatloaf
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Finely dice onion; line a rimmed baking sheet or grease loaf pan.
Mix beef, eggs, crumbs, onion, half the ketchup, salt and pepper gently.
Shape into a loaf. Mix remaining ketchup, brown sugar and mustard; spread over top.
Bake 55–65 minutes until center reaches 160°F.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing so loaf holds together.

name: French dip sandwiches with au jus
steps: Thinly slice onion. Sauté in a little oil over medium heat 8–10 minutes until golden.
Add broth and Worcestershire; simmer 5 minutes. Add sliced roast beef and warm gently until steaming.
Split rolls and toast under broiler 1–2 minutes, watching closely.
Lift beef and onions onto rolls; divide hot broth into small bowls for dipping. Serve immediately.

name: Beef stir-fry with cauliflower rice
steps: Slice beef thinly across grain; chop vegetables and mince garlic.
Heat a little oil in large skillet over high heat. Sear beef in batches 2–4 minutes until cooked to 145°F; rest 3 minutes.
Stir-fry vegetables 4–6 minutes; add garlic and soy sauce for final 30 seconds.
Return beef and toss. In separate skillet sauté cauliflower rice 5–7 minutes until tender and excess moisture evaporates.
Serve beef and vegetables over cauliflower rice.

name: Killer Angus burgers
steps: Preheat grill or skillet to medium-high. Season patties with salt and pepper.
Cook patties 4–6 minutes per side until centers reach 160°F. Add cheese during final minute.
Toast split buns on grill or skillet 1–2 minutes.
Spread burger sauce on buns; add lettuce and patties. Serve hot.

name: French onion beef stroganoff
steps: Cook noodles according to package and drain. Slice onions and mushrooms.
Heat a little oil in skillet over medium heat; cook onions 15–20 minutes until golden.
Add ground beef and mushrooms; cook 7–10 minutes until beef reaches 160°F and mushrooms brown.
Add broth and simmer 8–10 minutes to reduce. Lower heat and stir in dairy-free sour cream without boiling.
Serve over noodles; season to taste.

name: Smash burgers with caramelized onions
steps: Slice onions and cook in half the oil over medium-low heat 20–30 minutes until caramelized.
Divide beef into four or eight loose balls. Heat cast-iron skillet over high heat with remaining oil.
Place balls in skillet and smash thin with sturdy spatula. Season; cook 2–3 minutes until edges brown.
Flip and cook 1–3 minutes until 160°F. Toast buns.
Assemble burgers with onions and sauce. Serve immediately.

name: Low-acidity spaghetti meat sauce with meatballs
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Mix beef, egg and crumbs; shape into 16 meatballs.
Bake on lined sheet pan 18–22 minutes to 160°F.
Simmer marinara and grated carrot in saucepan 15–20 minutes until carrot softens. Add meatballs and simmer 5 minutes.
Cook spaghetti according to package; drain. Serve topped with sauce and meatballs.

name: Crispy beef and potato skillet
steps: Dice potatoes into ½-inch cubes and onion finely. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat.
Cook potatoes covered with a splash of water 8–10 minutes; uncover and crisp 5–7 minutes. Remove.
Brown ground beef and onion 6–8 minutes to 160°F; drain excess fat.
Add paprika and potatoes; toss until hot and crisp. Season to taste.

name: Sweet glazed pork ribs with roasted vegetables
steps: Heat oven to 300°F. Pat ribs dry and season with paprika and salt.
Place ribs in covered baking dish and bake 2½–3 hours until tender.
Mix BBQ sauce and sugar; brush on ribs. Increase oven to 425°F and bake uncovered 10–15 minutes.
Toss vegetables with oil and roast on separate pan at 425°F for 20–30 minutes until tender.
Rest ribs 5 minutes and serve with vegetables.

name: Carne asada bowls
steps: Mix lime juice, minced garlic and oil. Coat flank steak and refrigerate 20 minutes.
Heat grill or skillet over medium-high heat. Sear steak 4–6 minutes per side to 145°F; rest at least 3 minutes.
Warm rice and prepare listed bowl toppings. Slice steak thinly across grain.
Divide rice among bowls and add steak and toppings; finish with lime.
tips: Kitchen tip: use cooked rice and sliced avocado as the bowl toppings.

name: Classic stuffed bell peppers
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Halve peppers and remove seeds.
Brown ground meat in skillet, breaking it up, to 160°F for beef or 165°F for turkey.
Mix meat with cooked rice and sauce; fill peppers and arrange in baking dish.
Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes until peppers are tender and filling reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes.

name: Air fryer salmon bites
ing: ½ tsp each paprika, garlic powder and onion powder
steps: Pat salmon dry and cut into 1-inch cubes. Toss gently with oil, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper.
Preheat air fryer to 390°F. Arrange cubes in one layer in basket; cook in batches if needed.
Air fry 7–9 minutes, shaking halfway, until edges are browned and centers reach 145°F.
Serve immediately with rice or vegetables; avoid overcrowding for crisp edges.

name: Crispy oven salmon with lemon dill dip
ing: ½ tsp each garlic powder and paprika
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet and pat salmon dry.
Rub salmon with oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper. Place skin-side down.
Bake 10–12 minutes or until 145°F; broil 1–2 minutes if desired, watching closely.
Mix yogurt, mayo, dill, lemon juice and garlic in a bowl. Omit dill for a plain lemon dip.
Serve salmon with chilled dip on the side.

name: Lemon garlic tilapia
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Pat tilapia dry and arrange in a lightly oiled baking dish.
Mix oil, minced garlic, paprika, salt and pepper; brush over fish.
Bake 10–15 minutes until fish flakes easily and reaches 145°F.
Squeeze lemon over fish and sprinkle chopped parsley. Serve immediately; no honey needed.

name: Seared ahi tuna steaks
ing: 1 tbsp neutral oil, or as needed for cooking
steps: Whisk coconut aminos, sesame oil, lime, minced garlic and ginger. Coat tuna and refrigerate 10 minutes.
Pat excess marinade off tuna and press both sides into sesame seeds.
Heat skillet over medium-high heat with a little oil. Sear each side until crust forms; lower heat as needed to cook center to 145°F.
Rest briefly and slice across grain. Discard used marinade; serve with rice or vegetables.

name: Seafood boil
steps: Fill a large stockpot with enough water to cover ingredients; add Old Bay, halved lemons and garlic. Bring to a boil.
Add potatoes and boil 12–18 minutes until nearly tender. Add sliced fully cooked sausage for 5 minutes.
Add thawed precooked crab legs and peeled shrimp; cook about 4 minutes until shrimp are opaque and reach 145°F and crab is hot.
Drain carefully. Melt dairy-free butter and toss with seafood and potatoes; add extra lemon if desired.
Serve on a platter. If using raw crab or sausage, cook separately according to package and safe temperature.

name: Tuna patties
ing: ¼ cup chopped onion and parsley
½ tsp each garlic powder and paprika
steps: Drain tuna thoroughly and flake in a bowl. Finely chop onion and parsley.
Add crumbs, eggs, mayo, Dijon and seasonings; mix until mixture holds together.
Shape 6–8 patties. If loose, chill 10 minutes or add a little extra crumbs.
Heat a thin layer of oil in skillet over medium heat. Fry 3–4 minutes per side until golden and centers reach 160°F.
Drain briefly on paper towels. Double ingredients for a larger batch.

name: Tuna stuffed peppers
steps: Drain tuna and finely dice celery. Mix with mayo, lemon juice, Dijon, salt and pepper.
Wash peppers, halve lengthwise and remove seeds and membranes.
Divide tuna mixture among pepper halves. Chill until serving.
Serve cold; no cooking needed.

name: Tuna zucchini noodles
steps: Spiralize zucchini and pat noodles dry. Drain tuna and mince garlic.
Heat oil in skillet over medium heat; sauté garlic 30 seconds.
Add zucchini noodles and toss 2–3 minutes until just tender. Avoid overcooking.
Fold in tuna and lemon juice; warm through and season. Serve immediately.

name: Salmon patties
steps: Drain salmon, removing skin or bones if desired. Flake into a bowl.
Mix with egg, crumbs, mayo and mustard. Shape into six patties.
Heat oil in skillet over medium heat; fry 4–5 minutes per side until golden and centers reach 160°F.
Drain briefly and serve with lemon or a simple sauce.

name: Simple oven-baked salmon
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Line baking sheet and pat salmon dry.
Place skin-side down; brush with oil and season with salt, pepper and lemon juice.
Bake 12–18 minutes, depending on thickness, until fish flakes and reaches 145°F.
Rest 2 minutes and serve with lemon wedges.

name: Lemon garlic cod
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Pat cod dry and place in a baking dish.
Mix oil, minced garlic and lemon juice; brush over fillets. Season to taste.
Bake 12–15 minutes until fish is opaque, flakes easily and reaches 145°F.
Spoon pan juices over fish and serve hot.

name: Shrimp zucchini noodles with pesto
steps: Pat peeled shrimp and zucchini noodles dry. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook shrimp 2–3 minutes per side until opaque and 145°F; remove.
Add zucchini noodles and toss 2 minutes until just tender.
Return shrimp, remove from heat and toss with pesto. Serve immediately.

name: Crispy herb-crusted salmon
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Pat salmon dry and place skin-side down on lined baking sheet.
Mix crumbs, oil, parsley and garlic powder. Press mixture onto tops of fillets.
Bake 12–15 minutes until crust is golden and fish reaches 145°F.
Finish with lemon juice and serve promptly to keep crust crisp.

name: Shrimp pasta
steps: Cook pasta according to package; reserve ½ cup water and drain.
Pat shrimp dry and mince garlic. Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat.
Sauté garlic 30 seconds; add shrimp and cook 2–3 minutes per side to 145°F.
Toss with pasta, lemon juice and a splash of pasta water. Season and serve.

name: Blackened salmon (mild)
ing: ½ tsp each garlic powder, thyme and onion powder
steps: Pat salmon dry. Mix paprika, garlic powder, thyme and onion powder.
Rub fish with oil and spice blend. Heat cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear 3–5 minutes per side, adjusting for thickness, until crust forms and center reaches 145°F.
Serve immediately. No cayenne is needed for this mild version.

name: Honey sesame tuna bowls
steps: Drain tuna and flake into a bowl. Whisk mayo, honey or maple syrup, sesame oil and soy sauce.
Fold dressing into tuna; taste and adjust. Dice cucumber and avocado.
Warm rice separately and divide among bowls.
Top with tuna mixture, cucumber and avocado. Serve promptly; use coconut aminos if soy-free.

name: Thick white chicken chili
ing: 1 cup unsweetened dairy-free cream or coconut milk
steps: Dice onion and mince garlic. Drain and rinse beans; mash one can with a little broth.
Heat oil in Dutch oven over medium heat. Sauté onion 4–5 minutes; add garlic, cumin and oregano for 30 seconds.
Add remaining beans, mashed beans and about 2½ cups broth; simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in shredded chicken and simmer 15 minutes until 165°F. Add cream and warm gently.
Add remaining broth only if needed. Taste before salting; serve thick with optional toppings.

name: Chicken and gnocchi dumpling casserole
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Grease a 9×13-inch casserole dish.
Whisk cornstarch into cold milk until smooth. Heat broth in saucepan, add milk mixture and poultry seasoning; simmer 3–5 minutes until thickened.
Mix cooked chicken, gnocchi and vegetables in dish. Pour sauce over and stir to coat.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes; uncover and bake another 10–15 minutes until gnocchi is tender and center reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes before serving. Add broth if sauce becomes too thick.
tips: Timing note: allow 45–55 minutes including sauce preparation.

name: Tomato soup from canned sauce
steps: Dice onion and mince garlic. Heat oil in saucepan over medium heat.
Sauté onion 4–5 minutes; add garlic for 30 seconds.
Add tomato sauce, broth, sugar, salt, pepper and Italian seasoning. Simmer 10–15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Blend carefully if desired. Stir in optional milk over low heat without boiling.
Taste and adjust seasoning; serve warm.

name: Dairy-free gluten-free chicken pot pie
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Lightly grease a 9-inch deep pie dish.
Dice onion. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat; sauté onion and vegetables 5 minutes.
Stir in flour for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in broth and milk; simmer 4–5 minutes until thick. Season to taste.
Fold in cooked chicken; transfer filling to pie dish. Cover with crust, seal edges and cut steam vents.
Bake 30–35 minutes until crust is golden and filling reaches 165°F. Rest 10 minutes before serving.

name: Rotisserie chicken pot pie with mashed potato topping
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Lightly grease a 9×13-inch casserole dish.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add mixed vegetables and cook 4–5 minutes.
Sprinkle flour over vegetables and stir 1 minute. Gradually whisk in broth and milk. Add garlic powder, onion powder and thyme; simmer 4–5 minutes until thickened.
Stir in shredded chicken and taste before adding salt. Pour filling into dish; spread prepared mashed potatoes evenly over top and make ridges with a fork.
Bake uncovered 25 minutes until bubbling and center reaches 165°F. Broil 2–3 minutes if desired, watching closely.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
tips: Kitchen tip: Costco rotisserie chicken and broth can already be salty; taste the filling before adding salt.

name: One-pan chicken pot pie casserole
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Dice chicken, onion, carrots and celery; mince garlic.
Heat oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Brown chicken 5–6 minutes; add onion, carrots and celery and cook 5 minutes. Add garlic 30 seconds.
Stir in flour 1 minute, then gradually add broth and milk. Simmer 5 minutes until thickened; stir in peas and season.
Lay pastry over filling, trim excess and cut steam vents. Transfer skillet to oven.
Bake about 30 minutes until pastry is golden and chicken reaches 165°F. Rest 10 minutes before serving.

name: Tuna and veggie rice casserole
steps: Heat oven to 375°F and grease a 9×13-inch dish. Drain tuna and flake.
Heat oil in saucepan over medium heat; whisk in flour for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in broth and simmer 4–5 minutes until thick.
Combine sauce with tuna, cooked rice and vegetables; season to taste.
Spread in dish and bake 25 minutes until bubbling and center reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

name: Rotisserie chicken enchilada casserole
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Drain and rinse beans; shred chicken.
Spread a little sauce in a 9×13-inch dish. Layer half the tortillas, chicken, beans and sauce.
Repeat layers and top with cheese. Cover loosely with foil.
Bake 20 minutes, uncover and bake 5–10 minutes more until center reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

name: Traditional ground beef chili
steps: Dice onion; drain and rinse beans. Heat a Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown ground beef and onion 7–10 minutes to 160°F; drain excess fat.
Stir in chili powder and cumin for 30 seconds. Add beans, tomatoes and broth.
Bring to a simmer, reduce heat and cook uncovered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust salt; add broth if too thick. Serve hot.

name: Dairy-free tuna noodle casserole
ing: 3 tbsp each oil and GF flour
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Cook noodles just shy of package time and drain; drain tuna.
Heat oil in saucepan over medium heat; whisk in flour for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in broth and milk; simmer 4–5 minutes until thick.
Mix sauce, noodles, tuna and peas. Season and spread in greased 9×13-inch dish.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbling and center reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes.

name: Chicken sweet potato soup
steps: Dice chicken, peeled sweet potatoes, onion and carrots into bite-size pieces.
Add broth and vegetables to soup pot; bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer.
Add chicken and simmer 25–30 minutes until vegetables are tender and chicken reaches 165°F.
Taste and season; serve hot. Add broth if desired for a thinner soup.

name: Classic turkey chili
steps: Dice onion; drain and rinse beans. Heat a little oil in Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown turkey and onion 7–10 minutes, breaking up meat, to 165°F.
Stir in mild chili powder, beans and tomatoes. Add water if mixture is too thick.
Simmer uncovered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Taste and season before serving.

name: Spaghetti and meatball casserole
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Mix beef, pork, egg and crumbs; shape into meatballs.
Bake on lined sheet pan 18–22 minutes to 160°F. Meanwhile cook spaghetti and drain.
Reduce oven to 375°F. Toss pasta with marinara and layer in greased 9×13-inch dish with meatballs and ricotta.
Top with mozzarella and bake 20 minutes until center reaches 165°F.
Rest 5–10 minutes before serving.

name: Killer salsa chicken thighs
steps: Thaw thighs fully in refrigerator. Slice onion and place in slow cooker.
Add chicken, salsa and cumin; stir to coat. Cover and cook on low 5–6 hours or high 3–4 hours.
Check chicken reaches 165°F and shreds easily. Remove to plate and shred with two forks.
Return to sauce and stir. Serve over rice or in tortillas; never start with frozen chicken in slow cooker.

name: London broil without onion soup mix
steps: Slice onions and place in bottom of slow cooker. Pat beef dry and season.
Place beef over onions; add broth, minced garlic, Worcestershire and thyme.
Cover and cook on low 7–8 hours until fork-tender. Avoid opening lid unnecessarily.
Rest beef 5–10 minutes, then slice across grain or shred if very tender. Serve with cooking juices.

name: Beef and sweet potato stew
steps: Peel and cube sweet potatoes; slice carrots and chop onion. Cut beef into bite-size pieces.
Place beef, vegetables, broth and thyme in slow cooker. Season lightly.
Cover and cook on low 7–8 hours until beef is fork-tender and vegetables are soft.
Taste and adjust seasoning. For thicker stew, mash a few potatoes into broth.

name: Pulled pork
steps: Slice onion and place in slow cooker. Rub thawed pork shoulder with paprika and garlic powder.
Add pork and broth; cover and cook on low about 8 hours until fork-tender and easily shredded.
Transfer pork to board, remove excess fat and shred with two forks. Skim fat from cooking liquid.
Return pork to cooker, add BBQ sauce and enough cooking liquid to moisten. Serve warm.

name: Chicken vegetable soup
steps: Thaw chicken in refrigerator. Chop carrots, celery and onion.
Place chicken, vegetables, broth and thyme in slow cooker. Cover and cook low 5–6 hours.
Check chicken reaches 165°F. Remove, shred with two forks and return to soup.
Taste and adjust seasoning; serve hot.

name: Honey garlic chicken
steps: Thaw chicken. Whisk honey or maple syrup, soy sauce, minced garlic and vinegar.
Place thighs in slow cooker and pour sauce over. Cover and cook low 4–5 hours to 165°F.
Remove chicken. If thicker sauce is desired, simmer cooking liquid in saucepan 5–10 minutes.
Return chicken to sauce and serve. Use coconut aminos if soy-free.

name: Lemon herb chicken
steps: Thaw chicken; mince garlic and juice lemon.
Place chicken in slow cooker; add broth, lemon juice, garlic and oregano.
Cover and cook low 4–5 hours until chicken reaches 165°F.
Serve whole or shred; spoon cooking juices over chicken. Taste and season.

name: Teriyaki chicken
steps: Thaw chicken and place in slow cooker. Mix teriyaki sauce, broth and ginger; pour over.
Cover and cook low 4–5 hours until chicken reaches 165°F.
Remove and shred chicken with two forks. Return to sauce and stir.
Serve over hot rice; check sauce label for gluten and dairy.

name: Chicken curry
steps: Thaw chicken. Peel and cube potatoes and chop onion.
Place potatoes and onion in slow cooker, then chicken. Stir coconut milk and curry powder together and pour over.
Cover and cook low 5–6 hours until potatoes are tender and chicken reaches 165°F.
Stir gently, taste and season. Serve with rice if desired.

name: BBQ chicken
steps: Thaw chicken and slice onion. Place onion in slow cooker, then chicken and BBQ sauce.
Cover and cook low 4–5 hours until chicken reaches 165°F.
Remove chicken, shred with two forks and return to sauce.
Stir and serve in bowls or on buns; add extra sauce only if needed.

name: Chicken fajitas
steps: Thaw chicken; slice peppers and onion into strips. Place chicken and fajita seasoning in slow cooker with a splash of water.
Cover and cook low 4–5 hours until chicken reaches 165°F; add peppers and onion for final hour.
Remove chicken, slice or shred, then return to vegetables.
Squeeze lime over mixture and serve in tortillas or bowls.

name: Salsa verde chicken
steps: Thaw chicken and place in slow cooker. Pour salsa verde over and sprinkle cumin.
Cover and cook low 4–5 hours until chicken reaches 165°F.
Remove chicken, shred and return to sauce. Stir to coat.
Serve over rice or with tortillas; use mild salsa verde for non-spicy version.

name: Mississippi pot roast
ing: 1 tsp each garlic and onion powder
steps: Pat thawed roast dry and place in slow cooker. Add broth, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder and dairy-free butter.
Add optional mild pepperoncini or omit for less heat. Cover and cook low about 8 hours until fork-tender.
Remove roast and shred, discarding large pieces of fat. Skim fat from juices.
Return beef to juices and serve with potatoes or rice.

name: Classic chicken salad
steps: Chop cooked, chilled chicken into small pieces. Finely dice celery and onion.
In a mixing bowl stir mayo, Dijon, lemon juice, salt and pepper together.
Fold in chicken, celery and onion until evenly coated. Add mayo a tablespoon at a time if needed.
Cover and refrigerate 20–30 minutes. Serve cold on bread, crackers or lettuce. Dijon and lemon are optional; no dill, relish, fruit or nuts.

name: Traditional egg salad (no dill or pickles)
steps: Place eggs in saucepan and cover with cold water by 1 inch. Bring to boil, cover, remove from heat and let stand 12 minutes.
Transfer to ice water for 5–10 minutes; peel and chop. Finely dice celery and onion.
Mix mayo, mustard, salt and pepper in bowl; fold in eggs and vegetables.
Chill 20–30 minutes before serving. No dill or pickles.

name: Classic tuna salad
ing: ½ cup mayo, more as needed
steps: Drain 4–5 cans tuna thoroughly and flake into a mixing bowl. Finely dice celery and onion.
Mix mayo, Dijon and lemon juice with tuna; fold in vegetables.
Taste and add salt and pepper. Add extra mayo a tablespoon at a time if too dry.
Cover and chill 20–30 minutes. Serve cold. Omit Dijon or lemon for an even simpler version; no dill or relish.

name: Ham salad
steps: Cut cooked ham into chunks; chop celery. Pulse both in food processor until finely chopped, not puréed.
Transfer to bowl and stir in mayo, Dijon, minced onion and pepper.
Taste before adding salt because ham is salty. Add mayo as needed for spreadable texture.
Cover and chill 20–30 minutes before serving.

name: Killer salmon salad
steps: Remove skin and bones from cooked, cooled salmon; flake into bowl. Finely dice celery and red onion.
Whisk mayo, lemon juice, Dijon and pepper.
Fold dressing and vegetables into salmon gently. Adjust mayo as needed.
Chill 20–30 minutes or serve immediately over greens. Keep refrigerated.

name: Mediterranean tuna salad bowl
steps: Drain tuna and rinse chickpeas. Dice cucumber and red onion; slice olives.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice and chopped parsley in bowl.
Add tuna, chickpeas and vegetables; toss gently. Season to taste.
Serve cold or at room temperature promptly; refrigerate leftovers.

name: Tuna lettuce wraps
steps: Drain tuna and finely dice celery. Mix tuna with mayo, celery, mustard and lemon juice.
Wash and dry lettuce leaves; slice avocado.
Divide tuna mixture among eight leaves and top with avocado.
Serve immediately, or chill tuna separately until ready to assemble.

name: Israeli salad
steps: Wash cucumbers, tomatoes and parsley. Dice cucumbers, tomatoes and onion finely.
Combine vegetables and chopped parsley in bowl.
Whisk oil, lemon juice and salt; toss with salad just before serving.
For tomato-free version substitute diced bell pepper. Serve chilled.

name: Soy-free poke bowl
steps: Cook rice according to package; fluff and divide among bowls.
Cook tuna to 145°F if not already cooked; dice into bite-size pieces. Dice cucumber and avocado.
Whisk coconut aminos, sesame oil and lime juice. Arrange tuna, cucumber, avocado and carrots over rice.
Drizzle dressing over bowls and serve promptly. Keep cooked fish refrigerated until assembly if serving cold.

name: Chicken Caesar wraps
steps: Chop cooked chicken and romaine; wash and dry lettuce well.
Toss chicken and lettuce with dairy-free Caesar dressing in bowl.
Warm wraps briefly according to package to make pliable. Divide filling among wraps.
Fold sides inward and roll tightly. Slice in half and serve.

name: Mediterranean chicken salad
steps: Dice cooked, chilled chicken, cucumber and red onion; slice olives.
Whisk olive oil and lemon juice in bowl.
Add chicken, vegetables and olives; toss gently. Season to taste.
Chill or serve immediately over greens.

name: Chicken lettuce cups
steps: Wash and dry lettuce leaves; grate carrot and mince garlic.
Heat sesame oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Brown ground chicken 6–8 minutes, breaking it up.
Add carrot and garlic; cook 2 minutes. Stir in soy sauce and cook until chicken reaches 165°F.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and serve. Use coconut aminos if soy-free.

name: Skillet eggs with onions and chicken
steps: Heat oil in medium skillet over medium heat. Sauté shaved onions 5–8 minutes until golden.
Add cooked chicken and stir until hot (165°F). Spread evenly in skillet.
Make four wells and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook over medium-low heat 5–8 minutes until whites and yolks are set.
Sprinkle cheese over top, cover briefly to melt. Finish with pickled onions, salt and pepper.

name: Tortilla de patatas
steps: Peel potatoes and slice thinly; slice onion. Heat oil in nonstick skillet over medium-low heat.
Cook potatoes and onion gently 15–20 minutes until tender, stirring occasionally. Drain excess oil.
Beat eggs with salt in bowl; fold in potatoes and onion. Return mixture to lightly oiled skillet.
Cook over medium-low heat 5–8 minutes until underside sets. Slide onto plate, invert skillet over plate and carefully flip.
Cook other side 3–5 minutes until center reaches 160°F. Rest 5 minutes and slice.

name: Soft-boiled eggs
steps: Bring enough water to cover eggs to a gentle boil in saucepan.
Lower eggs carefully with spoon; simmer 6–7 minutes for soft yolks.
Transfer to ice water for 1–2 minutes, then peel gently. Season and serve.
Use pasteurized eggs for runny yolks; fully cook eggs for vulnerable diners.

name: Strawberry spinach smoothie
steps: Wash strawberries and spinach; hull strawberries and peel banana.
Add milk to blender first, then spinach, banana and strawberries.
Blend 30–60 seconds until smooth. Add a splash of milk if too thick or ice if desired.
Pour into glasses and serve immediately.

name: Roasted broccoli
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cut broccoli into even florets and dry thoroughly.
Toss with oil, minced garlic, salt and pepper. Spread on rimmed sheet pan without crowding.
Roast 18–22 minutes, turning halfway, until edges brown and stems are tender.
Serve hot; add lemon if desired.

name: Crispy garlic sweet potatoes
ing: ½ tsp each garlic powder, smoked paprika and onion powder
steps: Peel and cube sweet potatoes into ½-inch pieces. Microwave in covered vented dish 4–5 minutes until nearly tender.
Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Add potatoes in single layer and cook 6–8 minutes, turning occasionally.
Add garlic powder, paprika, onion powder, salt and pepper; toss. Finish with dairy-free Parmesan and parsley.
Air fryer alternative: toss raw cubes with oil and spices; cook at 400°F for 14–16 minutes, shaking halfway, until tender.

name: Spaghetti squash
steps: Pierce squash several times and microwave 3 minutes to soften. Carefully halve lengthwise and scoop out seeds.
Place halves cut-side down in microwave-safe dish with ¼ cup water. Microwave 8–12 minutes until flesh is tender.
Let cool briefly, then scrape flesh into strands with fork. Toss with oil, salt and pepper.
Oven alternative: roast cut-side down at 400°F for 35–45 minutes. Serve with cooked ground beef if desired.

name: Garlic reheated carrots
ing: 1 tbsp olive oil or dairy-free butter
steps: Heat oil or dairy-free butter in skillet over medium heat. Mince garlic.
Add garlic for 30 seconds, then cooked carrots and thyme.
Sauté 5–7 minutes, turning occasionally, until lightly browned and reheated to 165°F.
Finish with lemon juice, salt and pepper. Serve hot.

name: Garlic mashed potatoes
steps: Peel potatoes if desired and cut into equal chunks. Place in saucepan with garlic and cover with cold salted water.
Bring to boil, reduce to simmer and cook 15–20 minutes until fork-tender.
Drain well and return to warm pot for 1 minute to evaporate moisture.
Mash with dairy-free butter and warmed milk, adding milk gradually. Season to taste; avoid overmixing.

name: Sautéed garlic green beans
steps: Trim and wash beans. Bring salted water to boil; blanch 3–4 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in skillet over medium heat; add minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add beans and sauté 3–5 minutes until crisp-tender.
Finish with lemon juice, salt and pepper. Serve hot.

name: Dairy-free mac and cheese
steps: Cook pasta according to package and drain. Reserve a little cooking water.
Melt dairy-free butter in saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in flour for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in milk; simmer 4–6 minutes until thick enough to coat spoon.
Reduce heat and stir in dairy-free cheddar and mustard powder until smooth. Season to taste.
Toss with pasta; loosen with reserved water if needed. Serve immediately.

name: Microwave sweet potatoes
steps: Scrub potatoes and pierce each several times with fork.
Microwave one at a time on microwave-safe plate 5–8 minutes, turning halfway.
Check center with fork; microwave in 1-minute increments until soft. Rest 2 minutes.
Split and fluff with fork; add oil or dairy-free butter and salt.

name: Cilantro lime rice
steps: Rinse rice until water runs mostly clear. Combine rice, water and salt in saucepan.
Bring to boil, cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer according to package, usually 15–20 minutes for white rice.
Remove from heat and rest covered 5 minutes. Fluff with fork.
Stir in lime zest, juice and chopped cilantro. Taste and serve.

name: Seasoned black beans
steps: Drain and rinse beans. Add to saucepan with water, cumin and garlic powder.
Bring to gentle simmer over medium heat; cook 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Mash a few beans if thicker texture is desired. Add water if too dry.
Finish with lime juice and salt to taste. Serve warm.

name: Chipotle-style fajita vegetables
steps: Slice peppers and onion into even strips. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high to high heat.
Add vegetables in a single layer; cook 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly charred.
Add oregano and salt to taste during final minute.
Serve immediately while crisp-tender.

name: Ninja Speedi home fries
steps: Dice potatoes into ½-inch cubes and pat dry. Toss with oil, paprika and garlic powder.
Set Speedi to Air Fry at 400°F; place potatoes on crisper tray in lower position, in a single layer.
Cook 18–22 minutes, shaking or stirring halfway, until golden and fork-tender.
Season to taste and serve immediately. Cook in batches if crowded.

name: Ninja Speedi potato wedges
steps: Scrub potatoes and cut into equal wedges. Pat dry and toss with oil, garlic powder and salt.
Set Speedi to Air Fry at 390°F; arrange wedges on crisper tray in lower position.
Cook 22–28 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and tender.
Serve hot; avoid stacking wedges for best crispness.

name: Quick pickled onions
steps: Thinly slice red onion and pack into clean heatproof jar.
Heat vinegar, water, sugar and salt in saucepan, stirring until dissolved.
Pour warm brine over onions to cover. Cool briefly, then cover and refrigerate.
Chill at least 30 minutes before serving. Keep refrigerated and use within about 2 weeks; not shelf-stable.

name: Tartar sauce
steps: Finely mince onion. Stir mayo, relish, lemon juice and onion together in bowl.
Add optional Dijon and taste. For a pickle-free alternative omit relish and add a little extra lemon.
Cover and chill 30 minutes to blend flavors.
Serve cold with fish or tuna patties; refrigerate leftovers.

name: Crazy feta-style topping
steps: Crumble dairy-free feta into food processor. Add oil, lemon juice, garlic and yogurt.
Pulse until creamy but slightly chunky; scrape sides as needed.
Taste and adjust lemon or salt. Omit hot peppers for mild version.
Transfer to bowl and chill 20 minutes before serving.

name: Dairy-free cottage cheese
steps: Drain tofu and pat dry. Crumble about two-thirds into small curds in bowl.
Blend remaining tofu with yogurt, lemon juice, nutritional yeast and salt until smooth.
Fold creamy mixture into curds; adjust texture with a spoonful of yogurt if needed.
Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes before serving.

name: Burger sauce
steps: Finely mince pickled onion. Combine mayo, ketchup, mustard, onion and garlic powder in bowl.
Stir until smooth; taste and adjust. Omit onion for a plain sauce.
Cover and chill 15–30 minutes.
Spread on burgers or smash tacos; keep refrigerated.

name: Buffalo chicken dip
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Soften dairy-free cream cheese and shred cooked chicken.
Mix chicken, cream cheese, mild buffalo sauce and half the cheese in bowl.
Spread in small baking dish and top with remaining cheese.
Bake about 20 minutes until bubbling and center reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes; serve with crackers or vegetables.

name: Guacamole
steps: Halve avocados, remove pits and scoop flesh into bowl.
Mash with fork to desired texture. Stir in lime juice, minced onion and salt.
Taste and adjust lime or salt. Serve immediately.
If storing briefly, press wrap against surface and refrigerate to slow browning.

name: Dairy-free tzatziki
steps: Grate cucumber and squeeze out excess water using clean towel.
Mince garlic and mix with yogurt, cucumber, lemon juice and salt.
Cover and chill 20–30 minutes. Taste and adjust lemon or salt.
Serve cold with chicken bowls or vegetables; no dill required.

name: Homemade vinaigrette
steps: Combine vinegar, Dijon, salt and pepper in bowl or jar.
Slowly whisk in olive oil, or seal jar and shake until emulsified.
Taste and adjust vinegar or salt. Drizzle over salad just before serving.
Refrigerate leftovers and shake again before use.

name: Hummus
steps: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to food processor with tahini, lemon juice, garlic and oil.
Blend 1–2 minutes, scraping sides. Add cold water a tablespoon at a time until smooth.
Taste and adjust salt or lemon. Transfer to serving bowl.
Serve with vegetables or crackers; refrigerate leftovers.

name: Five-ingredient chocolate mug cake
steps: Use a large microwave-safe mug (at least 12 oz). Mix flour, sugar and cocoa thoroughly.
Add milk and oil; stir until no dry pockets remain, scraping bottom.
Microwave 60 seconds, then in 10-second increments up to 90 seconds until set.
Cool 2 minutes before eating; mug will be hot.

name: Light egg white dessert
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Use clean, grease-free bowl and beat egg whites with cream of tartar until foamy.
Gradually add sugar while beating until stiff glossy peaks form. Fold in vanilla.
Spoon into lightly greased oven-safe ramekins. Bake 10–15 minutes until set and centers reach 160°F.
Cool briefly and serve; texture may deflate as it cools.

name: Hot fudge sauce
steps: Combine coconut cream, cocoa and sugar in small saucepan over medium-low heat.
Whisk until smooth and warm; do not boil vigorously. Add chocolate chips and stir until melted.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and salt.
Serve warm. Refrigerate leftovers and reheat gently with a splash of dairy-free milk if needed.

name: Easy banana bread
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Grease or line a 9×5-inch loaf pan.
Mash bananas in bowl; whisk in eggs, oil and sugar.
In separate bowl mix flour, baking soda and salt. Fold into wet mixture just until combined.
Pour into pan and bake 50–60 minutes until toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes in pan, then transfer to rack before slicing.

name: Whole roasted turkey
steps: Thaw turkey in refrigerator (allow about 2 days for 8 lb). Heat oven to 325°F. Remove giblets and neck; pat dry, do not rinse.
Rub turkey with oil, salt, thyme and rosemary. Place onion, carrots, celery, lemon and garlic loosely in cavity or roasting pan.
Set breast-side up on rack in roasting pan. Roast about 2¾ hours, checking early; tent with foil if skin browns too fast.
Check thickest breast, innermost thigh and innermost wing for 165°F without touching bone.
Rest 20 minutes before carving. Reserve drippings for gravy; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

name: Homemade turkey gravy
ing: ¼ cup turkey fat or oil
steps: Strain turkey drippings and skim fat. Measure ¼ cup fat or oil and 2 cups combined drippings and broth.
Heat fat in saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Gradually whisk in broth mixture to prevent lumps. Bring to gentle simmer and cook 4–6 minutes until thickened.
Taste before adding salt; season with pepper. Thin with broth if needed and serve hot.

name: Tuna melts
steps: Mix tuna, mayo, celery, onion, mustard, salt and pepper.
Butter one side of each bread slice.
Build sandwiches buttered side out, with tuna salad and a slice of cheese inside.
Cook in a skillet over medium-low heat 3–4 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.

name: Spaghetti and meatballs
steps: Heat oven to 400°F.
Mix beef, egg, crumbs, garlic, Italian seasoning and salt, then roll into 16 meatballs.
Bake 18–20 minutes until they reach 160°F.
Warm marinara in a large pot, add the meatballs and simmer 10 minutes.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions, drain, and serve topped with sauce and meatballs.

name: Burgers and hot dogs
steps: Heat a grill or skillet to medium-high.
Shape beef into 6 patties, press a thumbprint into the center of each and season.
Cook 4–5 minutes per side until 160°F, adding cheese for the last minute.
Grill hot dogs 5–7 minutes, turning, until heated through and lightly charred.
Toast the buns and set out the toppings.
Check hot dog labels for gluten and dairy.

name: Breakfast for dinner: pancakes, eggs and bacon
steps: Heat oven to 400°F.
Lay bacon on a foil-lined sheet pan and bake 15–20 minutes until crisp.
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder and salt; stir in milk, 1 egg and oil until just combined.
Cook ¼-cup scoops on an oiled skillet over medium heat until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1–2 minutes more.
Scramble the 8 eggs in the same skillet over medium-low heat until just set.
Serve with maple syrup.
